title: Count benches
description: Counts all benches as they are at the end of the data.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench

title: Show benches on the map
description: Lists every bench; points appear on the map and click on one for its tags.
code: nodes n with n:amenity=bench

title: Libraries as areas
description: Libraries mapped as closed ways or multipolygons, drawn as polygons.
code: areas a with a:amenity=library

title: Every kind at once
description: `*` selects nodes, ways, areas and relations; each object appears once.
code: * x with x:amenity=library

title: Pick one element
description: Without a number, `pick` returns a single element: the one with the smallest id.
code: pick area a with a:amenity=library

title: Random sample
description: Five benches chosen at random; the session seed (42 unless set) makes the choice repeatable.
code: pick 5 nodes n randomly with n:amenity=bench

title: Random sample with own seed
description: A different seed gives a different but again repeatable sample.
code: pick 5 nodes n randomly using seed 7 with n:amenity=bench

title: Variables
description: A name keeps a set for later lines; it is computed once, and only if it is used.
code:
benches = nodes n with n:amenity=bench
count of benches
benches

title: Several results in one line
description: Commas separate outputs; each gets its own box on the right.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench, count of nodes n with n:amenity=waste_basket

title: Comments
description: Everything after `#` is a comment.
code:
# all post boxes
nodes p with p:amenity=post_box

title: Tag with a value
description: `w:highway=residential` (no spaces) is short for `w:highway == 'residential'`.
code: count of ways w with w:highway=residential

title: Comparison with spaces
description: With spaces, `==` compares; values may be quoted.
code: count of ways w with w:highway == 'residential'

title: Tag present
description: A tag on its own is true when the element has it, whatever its value.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=restaurant and n:name

title: Tag missing
description: `== none` is true when the tag is missing.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n:backrest == none

title: One of several values
description: `in` with a list tests several values at once.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop in [bakery, butcher, greengrocer]

title: None of several values
description: `not in` is false for elements without the tag, like `!=`.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop not in [supermarket, convenience]

title: And, or, not
description: Brackets group conditions.
code: count of nodes n with (n:amenity=cafe or n:amenity=restaurant) and not n:wheelchair=no

title: Keys with colons
description: A tag key may contain colons.
code: count of ways w with w:cycleway:right=lane

title: Keys in brackets
description: Brackets allow any key, also one with dots or computed from text.
code: count of nodes n with n:['addr:city'] == 'Bremen'

title: Numbers in tags
description: Tag values become numbers where a number is expected; `?? 0` replaces missing and unreadable values.
code: count of nodes s with s:amenity=bicycle_parking and (s:capacity ?? 0) > 20

title: Text fields
description: `.length` of a text counts its characters.
code: average of (nodes n with n:amenity=restaurant and n:name).map(n => n:name.length)

title: Ranges
description: `between … and` includes both ends.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.version between 2 and 5

title: Speed limits
description: `maxspeed` without a unit is read in km/h, as documented for OpenStreetMap; `??` handles values such as 'none'.
code: count of ways w with w:highway and (w:maxspeed ?? 0 km/h) > 50 km/h

title: Tall buildings
description: `height` without a unit is read in metres.
code: areas b with b:building and (b:height ?? 0 m) > 30 m

title: Height from the number of levels
description: Uses the height if there is one, otherwise three metres per level.
code: average of (areas b with b:building and b:building:levels).map(b => b:height m ?? b:building:levels * 3 m)

title: Converting units
description: Units mix freely within one measure; the result has the unit of the left side.

title: Large parks
description: `.area` is the geodesic area in m²; compare it with any area unit.
code: areas p with p:leisure=park and p.area > 2 ha

title: Length of the cycleway network
description: `.length` is the length of a way in metres.
code: sum of (ways w with w:highway=cycleway).map(w => w.length)

title: State at a date
description: `on` gives every object as it was at that moment.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on 2015-01-01

title: Other ways to write dates
description: Dates can also be written with month names; a month or year stands for its start.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on 1 Mar 2018

title: State every year
description: `on each year` counts the state at the start of every year: a time series.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on each year from 2010 to 2024

title: State every month
description: The same per month.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop on each month from 2022-01 to 2023-12

title: Edits per year
description: `from … to` selects versions (edits) instead of states; `per year` groups them by their time.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per year from 2010 to 2024

title: Deletions
description: Deleted versions appear among the edits of a period.
code: count of nodes n with n.deleted from 2023 to 2023

title: New benches
description: Version 1 is the creation of an object.
code: nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.version == 1 from 2024 to 2024

title: Edits per week
description: Weeks are ISO weeks, starting on Monday.
code: count of ways w with w:highway per week from 2024-01 to 2024-03

title: Relative dates
description: `… before` and `… after` shift a date.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on 365 days before 2024-01-01

title: Not edited for a long time
description: `.time` is the time of the version.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.time < 2015-01-01

title: Changed tag value
description: `.previous` is the version before; compares a tag across versions.
code: count of ways w with w:highway and w.previous:highway != w:highway

title: Pairs of versions
description: `way A -> way B` gives every two consecutive versions of the same way.
code: count of way A -> way B with A:highway != B:highway

title: Edit wars
description: Three versions within 30 days: one user's highway class was changed by another user and then restored.
code:
war = way A -> way B -> way C closer than 30 days with A.user == C.user and B.user != A.user and A:highway == C:highway and A:highway != B:highway
war

title: Who was involved
description: `war_B` projects the matches onto position B; `distinct of` removes duplicates.
code:
war = way A -> way B -> way C closer than 30 days with A.user == C.user and B.user != A.user and A:highway == C:highway and A:highway != B:highway
distinct of war_B.map(b => b.user)

title: Renamed places
description: Nodes whose name changed from one version to the next.
code: node A -> node B with A:name != B:name and B:place

title: Quick reverts
description: A highway class changed and changed back within a day.
code: way A -> way B -> way C closer than 1 days with A:highway == C:highway and A:highway != B:highway

title: All versions of an object
description: `.versions` lists every version of an element.
code: count of (pick way w with w:highway=motorway).versions

title: Time since the previous edit
description: `.unchangedBefore` is the time between a version and the one before.
code: average of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.version > 1).map(n => n.unchangedBefore)

title: Tag added later
description: Benches whose backrest tag was added in their latest edit.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n.version > 1 and n:backrest and n.previous:backrest == none

title: Who mapped the benches
description: `.creator` is the user of version 1; the distribution shows the most active ones first.
code: distribution of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench).map(n => n.creator)

title: Within a box
description: A box is written as longitude range, latitude range.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within 8.78...8.84, 53.06...53.09

title: Within a place
description: Place names are looked up among the boundaries in the database (change the name for other areas).
code: nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Vegesack

title: Within as a condition
description: `n within R` inside the condition means the same.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n within Vegesack

title: Outside a place
description: `not within` excludes a region.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n within Bremen and n not within Vegesack

title: Near something
description: Bicycle parking less than 50 m from a library (distances between the geometries).
code:
libraries = * l with l:amenity=library
nodes b with b:amenity=bicycle_parking and b near some _ in libraries closer than 50 m

title: Far from everything
description: Benches without a waste basket within 50 m.
code:
baskets = nodes w with w:amenity=waste_basket
nodes b with b:amenity=bench and b near no _ in baskets closer than 50 m within Vegesack

title: Near, default distance
description: Without `closer than`, `near` uses 100 m (setting `near_distance`).
code: * b near some _ in (* s with s:amenity=school) with b:amenity=bench

title: Nearest
description: `nearest of S to x` is the closest element of S.
code:
schools = * s with s:amenity=school
(pick 20 nodes n with n:amenity=bench).map(b => (nearest of schools to b):name)

title: Within areas
description: A set of areas works as a region.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within (areas p with p:leisure=park)

title: Overlapping
description: Buildings whose outline overlaps a given area.
code:
campus = pick area a with a:amenity=university
areas b with b:building and b overlapping campus

title: Coordinates
description: `.lon` and `.lat` of the representative point (for areas a point inside).
code: (pick 5 areas a with a:amenity=school).map(a => [a.lon, a.lat])

title: Around a station
description: Shops less than 500 m from a station (change the name for other databases).
code:
station = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
count of nodes s with s:shop and s near some _ in [station] closer than 500 m

title: Total park area
description: Sum of the areas of all parks.
code: sum of (areas p with p:leisure=park).map(p => p.area)

title: Largest parks
description: `ordered by` sorts before `pick` takes the first ones.
code: pick 5 areas p with p:leisure=park ordered by -p.area

title: Average building
description: Average footprint of buildings in a part of town.
code: average of (areas b with b:building within Vegesack).map(b => b.area)

title: Multipolygon relations
description: Areas made of several rings.
code: areas r with r:type=multipolygon and r:landuse

title: Lakes and ponds
description: Water areas larger than one hectare.
code: areas w with w:natural=water and w.area > 1 ha

title: Walking route
description: Shortest path on the street network from a library to the main station; `.length` and `.duration` describe it (change the name for other databases).
code:
a = pick node n with n:amenity=library
b = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
p = path P from a to b by foot
p.length, p.duration
p

title: Cycling route
description: The same by bicycle (15 km/h, one-way streets respected).
code:
a = pick node n with n:amenity=library
b = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
path P from a to b by bicycle

title: Ten minutes on foot
description: The area reachable within ten minutes of walking from the main station.
code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
isochrone I from s closer than 10 min by foot

title: Two kilometres by bicycle
description: Isochrones also work with distances on the network.
code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
isochrone I from s closer than 2 km by bicycle

title: Shops within walking time
description: An isochrone is a region and works with `within`.
code:
s = pick node n with n:railway=station and n:name='Bremen Hauptbahnhof'
reach = isochrone I from s closer than 10 min by foot
count of nodes x with x:shop within reach

title: Count per value
description: `per` groups by the value of an expression.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop per s:shop

title: Only large groups
description: `having` filters the groups after counting.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop per s:shop having count > 20

title: Shares
description: The share of each group; all shares add up to 1.
code: share of s in (nodes x with x:shop) per s:shop

title: Share with a condition
description: Without `per`, `share` measures how many fulfil the condition.
code: share of b in (nodes x with x:amenity=bench) with b:backrest=yes

title: Per district
description: A set of areas groups by the area each element lies in; the map shades the districts.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per (areas d with d:boundary=administrative and d:admin_level='9')

title: Per grid cell
description: Equal-area cells (EPSG:3035 in Europe).
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per cell of 1 km

title: Per map tile
description: Web Mercator tiles; the map shades them by count.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per tile at zoom 13

title: Two levels
description: Several `per` group by several keys.
code: count of nodes s with s:shop in [bakery, supermarket] per s:shop per year from 2015 to 2024

title: Filtering groups
description: `groups g in …` turns the rows of a grouped result into elements.
code: groups g in (count of nodes s with s:shop per s:shop) with g.count > 50

title: Chunks
description: `per chunk of N` cuts an ordered set into pieces of N.
code: count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per chunk of 1000 ordered by n.id

title: Distribution of values
description: How often each value occurs, the most frequent first.
code: distribution of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench).map(n => n:backrest)

title: Distribution of lengths
description: Many different numbers are put into classes with round bounds.
code: distribution of (ways w with w:highway=residential).map(w => w.length)

title: Entropy
description: Shannon entropy (bits) of the shop types: higher means more diverse.
code: entropy of (count of nodes s with s:shop per s:shop)

title: Concentration of edits
description: Gini coefficient of the highway versions per user: 0 even, 1 one user does all.
code: gini of (count of ways w with w:highway per w.user)

title: Spread
description: Standard distance of the libraries from their centre.
code: spread of nodes n with n:amenity=library

title: Density
description: Benches per km² of the region.
code: density of nodes n with n:amenity=bench within Vegesack

title: Correlation
description: Pearson correlation of two time series, paired by year.
code: correlate (count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per year from 2010 to 2024) with (count of nodes n with n:amenity=waste_basket per year from 2010 to 2024)

title: Regression
description: Least squares: slope, intercept and r².
code: regress (count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench per year from 2010 to 2024) on (count of nodes n with n:amenity=waste_basket per year from 2010 to 2024)

title: Forecast
description: Continues a time series linearly.
code: forecast 3 years of (count of nodes n with n:amenity=bench on each year from 2010 to 2024)

title: Power law
description: Fits a power law to the number of highway versions per user.
code: fit powerlaw to (count of ways w with w:highway per w.user).map(g => g.count)

title: Active users
description: Users with more than 500 changesets in the data.
code: count of users u with count of u.changesets > 500

title: Changesets in a period
description: Changesets that started in the first quarter of 2024.
code: count of changesets from 2024-01 to 2024-03

title: Editing streaks
description: Runs of consecutive days on which a very active user edited.
code:
u = pick user u with count of u.changesets > 1000
streaks of u.changesets

title: Keys in use
description: All tag keys in use at the end of the data.
code: count of keys

title: New keys
description: Keys in use now, with more than 100 elements, that did not exist in 2015.
code:
old = keys on 2015-01-01
(keys k with k not in old and k.count > 100).map(k => k.name)

title: Values of a key
description: `.count` and `.values` of a key: elements and distinct values.
code:
shop = pick key k with k.name == 'shop'
shop.count, shop.values

title: Own fields
description: `define` adds a field to all elements of a kind.
code:
define node N: edits = N.version - 1
average of (nodes n with n:amenity=bench).map(n => n.edits)

title: Transitions
description: How the class of a road changed over its versions.
code:
w = pick way w with w:highway and w.version > 10
transitions of w.versions.map(v => v:highway)

title: Classification
description: Predicts the missing backrest tag from the position (k nearest neighbours); also reports the accuracy.
code: classify (nodes n with n:amenity=bench) by n => n:backrest using n => [n.lon, n.lat]

title: Confusion table
description: How often two values occur together, element by element.
code:
b = nodes n with n:amenity=bench and n:backrest
confusion of b.map(n => n:backrest) with b.map(n => n:material ?? 'unknown')
